acceptanceCriteria: Retained OpenCode 2 evidence is committed, testedHostVersions and hostVersionEvidenceAdapterVersion name it, and the README MCP evidence covers OpenCode 2 or says it is untested.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 OpenCode 2 port (adapter 0.3.0) during the rc.2 adapter audit. integrations/opencode/package.json:40 testedHostVersions is [] although 2.0.18 was run live, and integrations/opencode/README.md:51-54 cites MCP probes only for OpenCode 1.17.18 and 1.18.31; OpenCode 2 mcp.servers with corvint-mcp was not exercised. The wire --adapter-version stays 0.1.0 (see V1-0444) while the manifest says 0.3.0. Commit retained live evidence, fill testedHostVersions, and set hostVersionEvidenceAdapterVersion to 0.3.0.
title: OpenCode testedHostVersions is empty and README MCP evidence names only 1.x
